summary_en: Nagase announced a share buyback program for up to 3.5 million shares with a maximum expenditure of 3 billion yen (0.86% of outstanding shares) through on-market purchases including ToSTNeT-3 transactions from November 9 to November 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Own Shares
translation_en_brief:
Nagase & Co., Ltd. announced a share buyback program approved by the Board of Directors on November 6, 2026. The company will acquire up to 3.5 million ordinary shares for a maximum of 3 billion yen, representing 0.86% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). Purchases will be executed through on-market transactions, including ToSTNeT-3 off-exchange trades, from November 9 through November 30, 2026.

The buyback supports the company's capital allocation strategy outlined in its mid-term business plan "Walk the Talk 2028," which emphasizes continuous dividend increases and opportunistic share repurchases as core shareholder return policies. Management determined that current market valuations, financial position, and investment capacity warrant the buyback to improve capital efficiency and enhance enterprise value.

As of October 31, 2026, the company held 31.3 million treasury shares against 408.3 million outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock).
